text:
Whoever was at the checkout tonight around 9pm needs to be trained or fired. I placed an order through the app and I had my order code. This is enough to get your order even when you are not using your phone's location to check into the restaurant. It literally says to just show the code to a crew member if you have any problem. I've done it many times before myself. This time I placed an order and my girlfriend went to pick it up for me, but the crew member refused to prepare the order by showing them the code. They insisted multiple times that it wasn't possible and that the only way was to complete the check-in using the smartphone's GPS inside the restaurant. This really pissed me off, as I even know first hand how to complete the order myself using their checkout screen as I have seen them doing it other times. They literally have a button that says "Mobile Order" and after they tap it they can introduce the order number as well as they get a list with the placed orders on the sidebar. Even a kid could do it. They just refused to do so.

There's no excuse for this. They cannot force customers to use their GPS as the only way to get their order, and the app itself offers alternatives for it. Whoever was working there, shouldn't be doing it anymore.
author: Gerard Reches

text: Horribly busy. As a kid 14 years ago I had a memory of a icecream come in the afternoon. 14 years later I cone back to give my sister the same magic experience on holiday in the afternoon with the lagoon lights and no icecream cones. Ordered 4 Sundays. No printer paper. Took 20 minutes, when it was ready had caramel all over the cups horribly. Then a older big women tried fixing it with a rag, did one and was like it wasn't cleaned. Horrible experience. You can cross the daintree river by ferry to and back quicker then this place. No drive through and can't handle it. Please don't go here! Please go to the one 2ks down the road. Also why shove the spoons into the end of a lardge caramel Sunday. I knew the person making had a disability wich is fine, but they need to be supervised. Don't leave them by themselves at the front in peak 6-7pm o'clock time. Manager needs to be sacked. Worst I've ever been too. Sticky hands. Simple quick order. Horrible. Literally will ruin your day in wich is a beatfull lagoon. Paid parking here too so speed needs to be imidiate.
author: Aaron Tanzer

text: The worker misunderstood our order, and put someone else’s coffee in our takeaway tray. My mum ordered it so I didn’t know that it wasn’t part of our meal. The worker came over and told us that we took someone else’s coffee, so we told her that it was part of our tray and we didn’t know that it was someone else. The waitress rolls her eye and gave us a very harsh attitude, so we got really confused. We are willing to pay for the extra coffee and their mistake, then the manager came and insisted that the order was right and that it was our fault that this whole thing happened. So this ended with them saying that we don’t need to pay for the coffee, which made us look like that we were trying to steal other people’s meal. Overall, the attitude of this maccas really disappointed me and the service is unbelievably bad. Really wish google could let me do a zero star for the service…
author: Jessie Shen

text: always dirty rubbish everywhere tables never clean which isn’t too bad i understand if there is a rush but the service is atrocious, rude staff all the time especially today. me and my friend were waiting for our order and after 10 minutes they finally called our number so we walked up to the counter and all three people on service turned away and started doing something else as if they were avoiding serving us. not knowing what was our food we tried to find our order and the manager turns around and said is this your order and we said we didn’t know which was ours so she snapped and said well let’s not go touching stuff that isn’t ours ok and then they told us they shoved our whole order into the one happy meal box. the laziness and disrespect is atrocious.

text: Restroom says “closed after 6pm, see manager for assistance”. I was completely sober, asked worker for a key, she said “no it doesn’t open”. I then asked manager, “please can I have the key to go pee quickly” and he said, “no it doesn’t open”. Two blatant lies right to the face which is super frustrating. Of course it opens, all you need is a key after 6. I’m a respectful, paying customer asking to use the restroom, please make it accessible if if the sign even says “ask manager for assistance”. It doesn’t say “restroom off limits after 6pm”. It says “ask manager for assistance after 6pm”. Lazy and rude. It’s just a restroom, please let your paying customers use it.

text:
